meta.name: prisma-cli
meta.description: Prisma ORM CLI commands reference covering init, generate, migrate, db, dev, complete, studio, validate, format, debug, and mcp. Use for ORM/database CLI workflows, not the Prisma Platform CLI. Triggers on "prisma init", "prisma generate", "prisma migrate", "prisma db", "prisma complete", "prisma studio", "prisma mcp".

copy.tagline: 查阅数据库 ORM 命令,管理数据表结构与迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用命令行操作数据库,需要快速查找 Prisma 命令
copy.tagline_en: Look up database ORM commands to manage schemas and run migrations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with databases via CLI and need quick Prisma command references

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会依据 Prisma ORM CLI 命令参考来回答用法,涉及初始化项目、生成客户端、数据库迁移与操作、Schema 校验等,并给出命令、参数和最佳实践;不覆盖 Prisma Platform CLI。
howto.when: 当你说出“prisma init”“prisma generate”“prisma migrate”等命令关键词,或要求初始化 Prisma 项目、生成客户端、运行数据库迁移时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化 Prisma 项目,数据库用 PostgreSQL。
say.note: Claude 会给出对应命令及参数。

say.text: 运行 migrate dev,并命名为 add_users_table。
say.note: Claude 会给出迁移命令并提示后续步骤。

say.text: 用 db pull 把现有数据库结构拉进 schema。
say.note: Claude 会说明拉取命令的用法。

howto.what_en: Claude answers Prisma ORM CLI usage: init, generate, migrate, db, dev, complete, studio, validate, format, debug, mcp, with options and best practices. Not for Prisma Platform CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions "prisma init", "prisma generate", "prisma migrate" (or other covered commands), or asks about initializing a Prisma project, generating the client, or running database migrations.

say_en.text: Initialize a Prisma project with PostgreSQL.
say_en.note: Claude gives the prisma init command.

say_en.text: Run migrate dev and name it add_users_table.
Pull the existing database schema with db pull.
